decisions.reason: After several years on the market, the award-backed yogurt appears to have validated demand in a core category, so keeping it is the more likely low-cost choice.
The mild creamy soft cheese sits close to the firm's established cheese offer and, having remained in the range for years, likely earned enough acceptance to justify continuation.
The washed-rind soft cheese is still the most exposed to pruning because of its narrower taste profile, but its survival so far suggests sufficient niche value to keep it for now.
